description:
USE WHEN you need one current, citable headline figure for the onchain agent ecosystem rather than a number from an article of unknown age: the ERC-8004 Identity Registry registered-agent count (read directly from Ethereum mainnet) and the curated Top Project Tokens index (only tokens of directory-listed projects, never the whole agent-token category or its aggregate market cap).
NOT FOR counts by venue, chain or stage (use onchain_agent_get_agent_economy instead), a time series (use onchain_agent_get_trend), or token prices for trading.

RETURNS (json): { erc8004: { network, registered_agents, live, checked_at, other_chains: { tool, args, note } }, top_agent_tokens: [{ symbol, name, current_price, market_cap, price_change_percentage_24h, resource_slug }] }. Read-only.

Example: { token_limit: 5 }

response_format.description: Text format; structuredContent is JSON either way.

token_limit.description: How many top project tokens to include (1-25, default 12).

name: onchain_agent_get_metrics
title: Live ecosystem numbers, read from chain
